acceptanceCriteria.statement: Holding D while clicking either chooser button (ORRERY or HELM) boots straight into Sol in the chosen mode — no intro logos, no title sequence; D-hold + mode click is the last interaction before you're in the system. Without D held, the normal boot ceremony is byte-for-byte today's.

verifyVia.input: Reload the app; hold D; click #splash-mode-orrery (then repeat for #splash-mode-helm). Control run: same clicks without D held.
verifyVia.observable: With D: Sol is the active system in the chosen mode and the logo/title sequence never displays after the click. Without D: logos, title, and normal post-choice boot flow appear unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The skip removes ceremony, never mode semantics: HELM-skip ends in the normal HELM post-boot state (landed, screensaver-tour arming, boot-aware regime reads incl. the e23050b boot-window behavior); ORRERY-skip arrives with nothing flying (orrery-coherence no-auto-warp/no-flight invariants hold) via the AC4 zoom-in arrival.

verifyVia.input: D-hold skip into each mode; read the same regime/arming probes a normal boot is verified with (window._regime(), tour-arm state, _effectiveRegime-dependent behavior).
verifyVia.observable: HELM-skip probe values match a normal HELM boot's post-boot twin; ORRERY-skip shows no self-flight or auto-warp within the observation window and lands at the AC4 overview end-state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The screen-space geometry lives in pure, TDD-built functions: (a) an orbit-visibility factor implementing the ratified rule — all planet orbits share one factor that reaches 1 when the outermost planet's screen offset clears the star's rendered glow disc, with a short fade band, honoring the user orbit toggle and regime gate; (b) an arrival spawn-distance rule placing the spawn just beyond the factor-zero point (star billboard, no planets distinct), respecting the existing wide-binary framing clamp.

verifyVia.input: Headless Vitest over the new pure functions with fixtures spanning Sol-like, tight, and wide-binary systems plus varying glow clamp / FOV / viewport values.
verifyVia.observable: Factor is 1 inside the threshold, 0 beyond the fade band, monotonic across it; user-toggle-off and HELM regime force 0; spawn distance always lands in the factor-zero zone and inside the wide-binary clamp; suite green.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every ORRERY system entry arrives via zoom IN, not out: nav warp, bg-star+Space warp, instant-cut viewSystem, and the D-hold boot skip all start at the far spawn (star rendered as billboard, no planets distinct, no orbit lines) and glide quickly (~1s, tunable) in to the existing overview frame with orbits visible at the end. No entry path retains the teleport-then-zoom-out arrival. The overview destination frame is unchanged from shipped orrery-coherence AC2.

verifyVia.input: Drive each of the four entry paths on :5173 via chrome-devtools; sample camera distance and star/planet/orbit visibility at arrival start, mid-glide, and settle.
verifyVia.observable: On every path: initial camera distance is at/beyond the AC3 spawn rule with no orbit lines rendered; distance decreases monotonically to the overview frame; orbits fade in during approach and are fully visible at settle; settle framing matches the pre-existing overview (same frame parameters as shipped AC2).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The premature orbit vanish is gone: orbit lines are visibly rendered at every camera distance from the overview out to the AC3 threshold, fade out smoothly across the short band when zooming out past it, and fade back in when returning. The user orbit toggle still wins at any distance, and HELM orbit behavior is unchanged.

verifyVia.input: From the overview in ORRERY, step the camera outward through a distance ladder to beyond the threshold and back; repeat with the orbit toggle off; check a HELM session for unchanged behavior.
verifyVia.observable: Pixel-level orbit-line presence at every ladder rung inside the threshold (the vanish distance Max hit is now inside the visible range); opacity ramps only within the fade band; toggle-off shows no orbit lines anywhere; HELM matches today.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The triplet coheres as one ORRERY entry grammar from Max's view: D-hold boot into both modes feels like a clean fast path; warping between systems in ORRERY reads as arriving INTO the system (billboard star -> zoom -> overview with orbits); orbits are visible wherever he expects them while zooming freely.
